implementation.public_path: Liquid-only simulations use the production realtime-single-step scheduler instead of the former blanket PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT rejection.
implementation.fixed_tick: Each successful population tick executes one 1/60 predictor, six density sweeps, one viscosity pass and one commit; there is no hidden substep or double integration.
implementation.common_epoch: Rigid and liquid leaves occupy disjoint ranges of one common spatial plan. Liquid queries and owner filtering consume its sole published epoch; no solve-time rebuild, refit, sort or second query occurs.
implementation.atomic_state: Positions, velocities, correction scratch and the time-advance counter are fixed-capacity staged resources. Exact-limit preflight failure publishes neither population and the next tick reuses the same allocations.
implementation.adapters: CPU, CUDA, Vulkan and Metal dispatch bindings call the same six frozen F8-12 Slang entry points. GPU drivers contain no serial CPU physics fallback.
